annotation.interpretation_a: All Initial packets sent *after* the Retry packet, regardless of whether they are part of a new connection attempt or a continuation of the same connection.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only the very next Initial packet sent immediately after the Retry packet, as part of a resumption attempt.
annotation.justification: The term 'subsequent' is open to interpretation. Does it mean all Initial packets sent after the Retry packet, or just the very next one? The lack of clarity impacts how a client would handle multiple connection attempts following a loss and the Retry packet.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'subsequent' refers to all future Initial packets or only the immediately following one. This affects how the client handles connection resumption after a loss.
